items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,300 to $2,900 on average. A used unit costs less but carries more risk.

items.t: Torque converter can fail and cut power (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Third-row seat anchor can rust loose (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Engine computer damaged by water leaks
items.job: Replace and program powertrain control module; repair water leak
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,300 for this repair.

items.t: Rocker panel, door and subframe rust
items.job: Cut out and weld in rocker panel sections, refinish
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,800 for rust repair. Subframe replacement costs more.

items.t: Misfire from a failing ignition coil pack
items.job: Replace ignition coil pack, spark plugs and wires

items.t: Misfire from clogged EGR ports in the intake
items.job: Clean intake EGR passages (upper intake removed)

items.t: Squealing camshaft synchronizer
items.job: Replace camshaft synchronizer

items.t: Front wheel bearing whine or hum
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing (one side)

items.t: Cracked wheel hubs or rotors (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Power steering line can come loose (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Power liftgate can drop suddenly (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: ABS and traction control lights on
items.job: Replace ABS/traction control module
items.note: A sensor or module reflash costs much less if that is the fault.

items.t: Rear brakes wear fast or calipers seize
items.job: Replace rear calipers, pads and rotors

items.t: Power sliding door or liftgate will not open
items.job: Diagnose and repair power sliding door motor, cable or latch

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: A/C compressor fails
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier and recharge

items.t: Power steering leak or hard steering
items.job: Replace power steering pump

items.t: Broken outer CV joint
items.job: Replace front axle shaft (one side)

items.t: Rear defroster and antenna stop working
items.job: Repair rear defroster terminal tab

items.t: Front power windows stop working
items.job: Replace front window motor/regulator
